upsert.title: PRISM: radiation-treatment access and funded follow-up for canine glioma
upsert.center: UC Davis Weill School of Veterinary Medicine / Translational Brain Tumor Center
upsert.status: Actively recruiting — UC Davis recruitment announcement published September 3, 2026
upsert.contacts: UC Davis Veterinary Center for Clinical Trials — (530) 754-1954; contact Dr. Christine Toedebusch / PRISM study team via the official UC Davis page
upsert.funding: Radiation pathway provides $3,000 toward radiation treatment and covers trial-related follow-up care, including follow-up visits and brain MRI examinations. The observational/palliative pathway instead provides $3,000 toward the initial diagnostic workup and covers trial-related follow-up care.
upsert.notes: OTHER TREATMENT-ACCESS OPPORTUNITY — not an experimental anticancer-treatment trial. PRISM is primarily a research/monitoring study. Dogs in its radiation pathway may receive standard radiation therapy according to the owner's wishes, with $3,000 study support toward radiation and funded trial-related follow-up. The study also has a non-treatment observational/palliative pathway.
